hooks.command: python3 -c "import sys,json,os; d=json.load(sys.stdin); fp=d.get('tool_input',d).get('file_path',''); b=os.path.basename(fp); (print('Blocked: .env contains API keys — edit manually.'), sys.exit(2)) if b in ('.env','.env.local','.env.production') else None"

python3 -c "import sys,json,os,subprocess,shutil; d=json.load(sys.stdin); fp=d.get('tool_input',d).get('file_path',''); shutil.which('ruff') and fp.endswith('.py') and os.path.exists(fp) and [subprocess.run(['ruff','check','--fix','--quiet',fp],capture_output=True), subprocess.run(['ruff','format','--quiet',fp],capture_output=True)]"
